# Network

Questions:

-   How was the network generated?

-   How did you come up with the scaling factors of 66% or 68%?

CRS = 2450!!!!

```{bash}
ls data/matsim_inputs | grep -i net

# open -a Via data/matsim_inputs/NetworkRed191211fromJOSM_noHighway_cle_speed0.66Adjusted.xml

```

Looking at the network, we see that it is simply a bounding box around the area of Gunma.

![](images/clipboard-3869763261.png)

Here we see that the two networks differ in freespeed, this is how Lichen scaled down from 100% to 2.5%.

Hmmm... but the average "freespeed" is still 26kmh. I feel like that is too high, if we've really scaled down 40x. So apparently the 66 and 68 refers to the scaling factor of the freespeed.

```{r}
library(sf)
library(tmap)
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
install.packages("devtools")
library(devtools)
devtools::install_github("matsim-vsp/matsim-r", build_vignettes = TRUE)
library(matsim)

net66 <- read_network("data/matsim_inputs/NetworkRed191211fromJOSM_noHighway_cle_speed0.66Adjusted.xml")$links %>% mutate(scenario = "66")

net68 <- read_network("data/matsim_inputs/NetworkRed191211fromJOSM_noHighway_cle_speed0.68Adjusted.xml")$links %>% mutate(scenario = "68")

net_comb <- bind_rows(net66,net68)

net_comb %>%
  group_by(scenario) %>% 
  summarise(freespeed = mean(freespeed), capacity = mean(capacity))

7.230469 *3.6 / .66
7.449574 * 3.6 /.68


```

# Population

-   why are there so many plans?

-   why do all the plans have different population sizes, if they all come from the travel survey?

-   why are the only two attributes available are "bicycAvail" and "carAvail"?

```{bash}
ls data/matsim_inputs/ | grep -i plans
```

```{bash}
cd data/matsim_inputs/
echo "file,cnt,pop" > plans_wc.csv
for f in Plans*; do
  if [ -f "$f" ]; then
    lines=$(wc -l < "$f")
    pop=$(grep "person id=" $f | wc -l)
    echo "$f,$lines,$pop" >> plans_wc.csv
  fi
done
```

```{r}
cnts <- read_delim("data/matsim_inputs/plans_wc.csv", delim=",") 

cnts %>% arrange(pop) %>% view()

```

We can see that people conduct activities from the plans file. However, we cannot see routes, because these are all input files and no output files w/ routes or events...

# Supermarkets

Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tmap)
library(tmaptools)
library(sf)
library(osmdata)
library(osmextract)

```

Create buffer around Gunma

```{r}

shp_gunma <- st_read("../public-svn/matsim/scenarios/countries/jp/gunma/gunma-v1.0/input/shp/gunma_2450/gunma_2450.shp")

shp_gunma_buff <- st_buffer(shp_gunma, 5000) %>% st_transform(4326) 

bbox_buf <- shp_gunma_buff %>% st_bbox()

tmap_mode("view")
tm_shape(shp_gunma_buff) + tm_borders() + tm_shape(shp_gunma) + tm_borders()
```

Function for grabbing osm data for a specific key/value pair and cleaning

```{r}

grab_osm_data <- function(keyy,valuee) {
  osm_data <- opq(bbox_buf) |>
  add_osm_feature(key = keyy, value = valuee) %>% 
  osmdata_sf()

  points <- osm_data$osm_points
  polygons <- st_make_valid(osm_data$osm_polygons) 
  polygon_centroids <- polygons %>% st_centroid()

  points_within_polygon <- points %>%
  st_filter(polygons %>% st_buffer(5))

  points_clean <- points %>% filter(!osm_id %in% points_within_polygon$osm_id)

  points_combined <- bind_rows(
  points_clean %>% mutate(source = "points") %>% select(osm_id,source),
  polygon_centroids %>% mutate(source = "polygons") %>% select(osm_id,source))

  points_final <- points_combined %>% st_filter(shp_gunma_buff) %>% st_transform(2450) %>% mutate(type = valuee)
  
  return(points_final)
}


          
```

Supermarket

```{r}
points_final_supermarket <- grab_osm_data("shop","supermarket")
tm_shape(shp_gunma_buff) + tm_borders() + tm_shape(points_final_supermarket) + tm_dots()
```

Public Baths

```{r}

points_final_baths <- grab_osm_data("amenity","public_bath")

tm_shape(shp_gunma_buff) + tm_borders() + tm_shape(points_final_baths) + tm_dots()
          
```

Hospital

```{r}

points_final_hospital <- grab_osm_data("amenity","hospital")

tm_shape(shp_gunma_buff) + tm_borders() + tm_shape(points_final_hospital) + tm_dots()
          
```

combine

```{r}
points_final <- bind_rows(points_final_supermarket,points_final_baths,points_final_hospital)
```

Plot results

```{r}
tmap_mode("view")
  tm_shape(shp_gunma, ext = 1.1)+
  tm_borders() +
tm_shape(points_final) +
  tm_dots(fill = "type", size = .4) 
```

Save Output

```{bash}

rm -rf ../public-svn/matsim/scenarios/countries/jp/gunma/gunma-v1.0/input/osm_buffer5km/

mkdir ../public-svn/matsim/scenarios/countries/jp/gunma/gunma-v1.0/input/osm_buffer5km/

```

```{r}
st_write(points_final, "../public-svn/matsim/scenarios/countries/jp/gunma/gunma-v1.0/input/osm_buffer5km/poi_2450.shp")

points_final %>% 
  mutate(
    x = st_coordinates(.)[, 1],
    y = st_coordinates(.)[, 2]
  ) %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  select(x,y,type) %>% 
  write_csv("../public-svn/matsim/scenarios/countries/jp/gunma/gunma-v1.0/input/osm_buffer5km/poi_2450.csv")


```
